question_text: Modern education system in greatly dependent on
stimulus: technology. It is helping us in many ways. Now, write a dialogue between you (Farzana) and your friend (Soma) on the impact of technology on our education. 10 Subject Code : 1 0 7 the late 1880's the worker could not move in a organized way. On may 1st in 1886, inspired by the trade union half of the workers at McCormic Harvester Company in Chicago went on a strike demanding an 8 hour work day. Two days later, 6,000 workers joined a workers rally near McCormic Harvester Company. The labourer leaders addressed the rally. The police were trying to disperse the meeting. At one stage the police reacted by firing on the workers killing one striker instantly, five or six others seriously wounded and many badly injured. The events of May day 1886 is a reminder that workers will continue to be exploited until they stand up and speak out to gain better working conditions, better pay and better lives. [Unit-3; Lesson-2]

subject: English
question_text: Why is May 1st called international workers day?
stimulus: May 1st, International Workers Day commemorates the historic struggle of working people throughout the world, and is recognized in most countries. All the privileges workers enjoy today a minimum wages, safety laws and eight-hour workday came in about due to the sacrifice of the workers in 1886. Since the Industrial Revolution in the 18th and 19th centuries, working conditions in Europe and the United States were severe and it was quite common to work 10 to 16 hours a day in unsafe conditions. Death and injury were common a many places. As early as the 1860's, working people agitated to shorten the work day without a cut in pay, but it wasn't until | 145 (h) He was the third child in a family of four daughters and two sons.  Part B : Writing Test (50 Marks)
